summary: Iteration 47: Full E2E testing of Status Page extensions — Uptime windows (24h/7d/90d), public email Subscribe box, public incident history, admin auto-incident toggle, incident-management CRUD, and auto-incident->public-visibility loop. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed. Frontend: 6/6 flows verified on public /status and /admin Deployment tab.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy_center.py has grown to >1000 lines; splitting into diagnostics, deploy-bundle, status-page and subscribers submodules would improve maintainability.

_notify_subscribers iterates subscribers and awaits each send_email_detailed sequentially — under real Mailgun/Resend keys this will block for O(subscribers) per incident update; consider fanning out with asyncio.gather with a bounded semaphore.
GET /api/status/public still recomputes windowed uptime by scanning diagnostics_history each request; add TTL cache or pre-aggregate into a rolling document.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_iter47 subscribers (unique emails), 2 TEST_iter47 manual incidents (both resolved during test), 1 TEST_ui_iter47 manual incident (posted, updated, resolved), and triggered an extra diagnostics run (auto-opened Email delivery incident visible on /status).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: GET/PUT /api/admin/deploy/status-page (with auto_incidents, subscribers, open_incidents), POST /api/status/subscribe (valid/duplicate/invalid/404-when-disabled), GET /api/admin/deploy/status-incidents, POST /api/admin/deploy/status-incidents (manual create), POST /api/admin/deploy/status-incidents/{id}/update (text + resolve), GET /api/status/public (windows [24h,7d,90d] with pct+strip per group, incidents timeline). Frontend verified on public /status: uptime-window-tabs with 3 buttons, all 4 status-group-* rows and status-uptime-* pcts, subscribe-email/submit -> subscribe-success, duplicate -> 'already subscribed' message, status-incident-row shows Investigating/Resolved chip + degraded/outage badge + updates. Admin Deployment tab: status-page-card with auto-incident-toggle (toggles persist), subscriber-count + open-incident-count chips (6 subs / 1 open at test), manage-incidents-btn opens manage-incidents-panel, new-incident-group/impact/text/post creates pub-incident-row, incident-update-* and incident-resolve-* work; after resolve the controls are hidden. Auto-incident loop confirmed: run-diagnose-btn -> Email delivery degraded auto-opens an incident that becomes visible in /status page incident history. Email delivery to subscribers itself is best-effort and fails silently in this env (no Mailgun/Resend key) — expected, per main-agent note.
